proposals.notSelectedNotificationTemplate:
Hi {name},

Thank you for submitting "{proposal}". After community voting, it was not selected in this round.

The results are published on the decision page, and we hope you will take part again.
proposals.selectedNotificationTemplate:
Hi {name},

Great news — your proposal "{proposal}" has been selected based on voting results!

We will follow up with next steps and the final amount shortly.

decisions.cowopResultsHeader: COWOP's Funds Oversight Committee has made final decisions on allocating our first $100,000!
decisions.cowopResultsAbout: <p>After careful deliberation and interviews with all proposal teams, COWOP proudly announces the final projects to be funded through our bottom-up budgeting process!  An <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Vut_98L7WK2G9lJfF2fX2GG_gWQYpNpmnNRJLgAJUL4/edit?tab=t.jc1uksmlpuqv">expert team</a> reviewed 17 total proposals in line with our <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1REwc6lk0ZC6CWfUjEbNVkDWZIG9j0-gZbLls5XsGu4k/edit">funding rubric</a> and has decided to fund nine of them, mostly close to the full amount requested.  Congrats to all who participated, and set the stage for allocating our remaining $100,000 next year!</p>
decisions.horizonResultsAbout: <p>Learn more about the process and how decisions were made <a target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer nofollow" href="https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1umMJylcpBaMtT2OLnO4THaj2aPzJqyz_g73Wi2VCyLQ/edit?slide=id.g355b90e2c0a_0_0#slide=id.g355b90e2c0a_0_0">here </a> </p>
